clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says McDonald's fries used to be cooked in beef fat - by most accounts the best-tasting fries you could buy.

Then saturated fat got blamed for heart problems, and the companies selling hydrogenated vegetable oil benefited most from that panic, in his view. McDonald's switched to vegetable oil, and fast food never tasted quite the same again.

The oil used is usually printed right on the menu board or nutrition page - worth a quick look.

Ever notice fries don't taste like they used to? Comment HEALTH and I'll tell you the oils we keep in our kitchen.
